transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hi. Thank you so much for taking the time to see me, I really appreciate it. 

I, um... I guess I'm here because I've been feeling a little stressed lately, and I hope it's okay to bring this up. I don't want to sound silly or make a big deal out of nothing. It's just... for a while now, I've had this feeling that certain people in the arts and finance circles here in Cincinnati are, well, quietly tracking which clients I meet with. 

I know how that sounds, and I constantly tell myself it could just be a coincidence, but... it feels like they're sending me little signals. You know, through the networking invitations I get, or the specific topics they choose for panels, or even just who happens to be seated near me at events. 

I really try to just brush it off and be professional, but I just can't seem to let it go. Is that... does that make sense? I just want to make sure I'm doing the right thing by coming in to talk about it.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds when there's no one around, or that other people couldn't hear?

Oh, um... no. No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I've never heard voices or sounds that aren't there. 

I really hope I didn't give you the impression that I was... I mean, I know what I said about the networking events probably sounds a little strange, but it's really just those signals I mentioned. I definitely don't hear things. 

Is it... is it okay that I don't? I hope it's alright that I'm just dealing with the other stuff. I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information and not wasting your time.
About how long have you been noticing these signals and feeling like you were being tracked?

Um... well, it really hasn't been that long, I don't think. I'd say maybe... about two months? Give or take. 

I think that's when I first started noticing the little signals and feeling like they were keeping tabs on my client meetings. I really tried to just ignore it at first, you know, because I didn't want to make a fuss or seem dramatic. I kept telling myself it would just pass. 

Is two months... is that a bad amount of time to wait before talking to someone? I really hope I didn't wait too long to bring it up. I just wanted to be absolutely sure it was an actual pattern before I bothered you with it. Am I doing the right thing by mentioning it now?

Oh, no, no. Nothing like that. I'm in complete control of my own body and what I do. I promise. 

I know the stuff about the signals and the meetings sounds a bit... out there, and I really hope I'm not coming across as completely unhinged. But my actions are always my own. No, my feelings haven't really been all over the place, if that's what you're asking. It hasn't been like a rollercoaster or anything where I'm suddenly panicking and then completely fine. It's just... been a steady sort of awareness, I guess. 

I really try to keep a level head about it all. With my job, you know, managing people's portfolios, you can't really afford to be overly emotional or erratic.
